thread:
Incident Bot: RED ALERT: autoscaler error on us-west2-gpu-pool. queue_length=12340, avg_lat=5600ms, failed_scale_attempts=3. docs: https://internal.redwood/ops/autoscale-runbook :rotating_light:
Alice Chen: seeing a huge backlog on the inference queue, 95% GPUs at capacity, throttling at 429 for many requests. This is affecting hosted-api (prod).
Mateo Rivera: pulling logs now. early signs: GCP quota error when trying to request new instances -> 
Mateo Rivera: `ERROR: quotaExceeded -> Insufficient GPUs available in region us-west2 for requested accelerator type`
Priya Singh: oncall handoff in 10m, can confirm paging SRE Oncall now.
SRE Oncall: I'm oncall, taking this. current impact? which customers?
Customer Success: multiple customers reporting high latencies and 5xxs. CS-92 and enterprise-ops reported errors in the last 10m.
Alice Chen: traffic ramped due to a scheduled batch for a PLG customer, burst exhausted reserved capacity and autoscaler couldn't provision. routing fallback didn't trigger because secondary region policies require capacity check.
Infra Bot: autoscaler logs: `scale_attempt_id=af3e, status=FAILED, reason=quotaExceeded`, retries exhausted.
SRE Oncall: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable emergency cross-region fallback to us-east1 (force-route), 2) manually add burst capacity to dedicated pool (if quota), 3) pause non-critical PLG ramp.
Priya Singh: I'll open a temporary throttle on the scheduled job via rate-limit rule. patch: `/services/ingress/rate-limits` update.
Mateo Rivera: I can try to trigger fallback routing by toggling policy flag `allow_fallback_on_quota` to true for prod. This bypasses the capacity check and will route to secondary if primary returns 503/429.
Ops-Jen: +1 to forcing fallback, but beware of cold starts in us-east1 for large models (latency spike). we should notify CS.
Alice Chen: agreed. timeline: enable fallback now, pause PLG ramp in 2m, attempt manual pool expansion in parallel.
SRE Oncall: executing step 1: toggling `allow_fallback_on_quota=true` for prod routes. Command: ```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/route-config -d '{"allow_fallback_on_quota":true,"env":"prod"}'
```
Incident Bot: ACTION: toggle recorded by SRE Oncall.
Mateo Rivera: routing toggle applied, confirming downstream: us-east1 receiving rerouted requests, initial success with 200s but increased p99 latency ~2.1s for some models. queue in us-west2 still grows but at slower rate.
Customer Success: alerting affected customers about degraded performance and mitigation steps. posting updates to CS channel. :phone:
Priya Singh: paused the scheduled PLG ramp via infra API. job_id=plg-batch-2026-03-14 paused. queue drain starting.
Infra Bot: manual pool expansion: requested additional GPUs in us-west2 but cloud provider returned `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` for type A100, fallback to smaller GPU type attempted.
Arjun Patel: note: fallback to smaller GPU will affect throughput per-instance and model selection; only use if absolutely needed.
SRE Oncall: manual expansion failed. we'll rely on cross-region routing plus rate-limit for now. setting a temporary throttle on non-enterprise customers to protect SLOs.
Alice Chen: updating runbooks and running a quick smoke-test across both regions.
Mateo Rivera: metrics: errors down from 18%->4% after fallback + throttle. queue length peaked at 12.3k now down to 3.2k. good progress.
SRE Oncall: can the infra team follow up with cloud provider to resolve quota? assign to Arjun.
Arjun Patel: opened ticket with cloud provider case# CP-98765, requesting capacity recount and temporary quota bump for us-west2.
Ops-Jen: postmortem notes to capture: scheduled PLG ramp should be limited by autoscaler backoff; route fallback policy should have an auto-enable on quota errors; alert thresholds for queue_length need lowering.
Priya Singh: oncall handover at +50m — I'll prepare detailed notes.
SRE Oncall: handing off to Priya for next shift. summary: root cause = regional GPU exhaustion + autoscaler unable to provision due to cloud quota; mitigation = forced cross-region fallback + paused ramp + throttle; current status = serving via us-east1 with higher p99 latency, queue draining, major customers stable.
Priya Singh: taking over. I will keep the fallback flag on until cloud provider confirms capacity or dedicated capacity added.
Customer Success: CS posted status update to customers, marking incident as "mitigated" but still under monitoring.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. incident id INC-2026-03-14-1775000000.
Alice Chen: action items: 1) add automatic fallback-on-quota to routing policy (owner: eng-routing), 2) throttle guard for scheduled ramps (owner: infra), 3) runbook update: add quota errors path (owner: SRE).
Arjun Patel: will follow up with cloud provider and report in 4h window.
SRE Oncall: closing active paging. next steps — postmortem planned, will tag all owners. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
Priya Singh: note for postmortem: include customer impact table, timestamps, commands used, and decision timeline.
Ops-Jen: adding to incidents backlog and scheduling a retros meeting tomorrow.
Customer Success: leaving a note to proactive outreach for affected enterprise customers.
SRE Oncall: incident timeline pinned to channel as summary. end of thread.
